items.title: Collar-video row: viral clip shows Rahul Gandhi pulling DK Shivakumar back; Himanta Sarma attacks, DK denies humiliation
items.summary: A video from Monday's (Oct 12) INDIA-bloc march toward the Supreme Court went viral showing Rahul Gandhi appearing to pull Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar back by the collar of his kurta as he moved to the front of the procession; BJP's Anand Gurumurthy claimed another camera angle showed a collar grab. Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma shared the clip on X on Oct 13, calling it public humiliation and paralleling his own 2015 Congress exit. DK Shivakumar denied being pushed or humiliated, saying Rahul only asked him to return to the vehicle out of safety concern ('A 10-second video cannot tell the whole story') and accusing BJP of spreading fake news; Karnataka Dy CM G Parameshwara called it a crowd-shuffle misunderstanding. Tejasvi Surya, BY Vijayendra and the BJP handle also weighed in.
